name: Amandira

seo.title: Amandira Phinisi: Aman's Private Yacht in Indonesia | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Amandira, Aman's 52-metre phinisi for up to 10 guests in five cabins with a crew of 14, sails Komodo, Raja Ampat, the Spice Islands and Alor as a private charter.

tagline: A 52-metre phinisi for up to ten guests in five cabins, with a crew of 14.
answer: Amandira is Aman's 52-metre (170 ft) two-masted phinisi, handcrafted from local hardwoods by Konjo artisans and completed in 2014. She takes up to 10 guests in five air-conditioned cabins, with a crew of 14 that includes two chefs, a dive master and a spa therapist. Aman sails her as a private yacht for one party, on five published voyages: Komodo and the Amanwana Expedition from Labuan Bajo, Raja Ampat from Sorong, the Spice Islands from Ambon and the Alor Islands from Maumere. Aman publishes no rates; James quotes each charter for your dates and route.

overview: Amandira is a classically styled phinisi, the two-masted wooden ship of Indonesia's spice-trade era, built as a sailing and diving vessel. Konjo artisans handcrafted her from local hardwoods over a five-year collaboration with Aman, the naval architect Michael Kasten and the interior designer Deirdre Renniers; she was completed in 2014 and inaugurated in 2015.

She has five air-conditioned cabins, each with its own bathroom: the Master Cabin in the stern with views over the water, two Deluxe Cabins on the port and starboard sides, and two Single Cabins with bunk beds. On deck are a foredeck lounge, a sundeck, and indoor and outdoor places to lounge and dine, with a TV and a library. Meals run from sunrise onward, Indonesian, Asian-inspired and international.

Aman publishes five voyages for her: Komodo, the Amanwana Expedition from Labuan Bajo to Aman's tented camp on Moyo Island, Raja Ampat, the Spice Islands of the Banda Sea and the Alor Islands. Aman says she moves across the archipelago with the season, but publishes no months, dates or rates.
why: A hand-built phinisi of local hardwoods, five cabins for up to ten guests, and a crew of 14 with two chefs, a dive master and a spa therapist. The whole yacht goes to one party, on a route Aman tailors to it.

Five published voyages across eastern Indonesia, from the Komodo dragons and Raja Ampat's manta rays to the Spice Islands and the Alor Islands, which Aman calls remote and the least-visited part of East Nusa Tenggara.

days.label: Stop 1
days.title: Sorong to Mioskon
days.summary: Aman says the expedition traditionally begins in Sorong, with a first day of cruising to Mioskon Island and its dive sites.

days.label: Stop 2
days.title: The Waigeo coast and Yanggefo
days.summary: Lunch at Yanggefo, then snorkelling, diving and kayaking through the mangroves.

days.label: Stop 3
days.title: Across the Equator to Wayag
days.summary: Snorkel or dive across the Equator, then Wayag, which Aman describes as the first documented manta ray nursery in Southeast Asia.

days.label: Stop 4
days.title: Mount Pindito
days.summary: A climb of about 200 metres up the limestone karst of Mount Pindito for the view over the islands.

days.label: Stop 5
days.title: A pearl farm and its reef
days.summary: A tour of a pearl farm, then a dive on a nearby reef known for ghost pipefish and blue-ringed octopus. Aman does not name the farm's island.

days.label: Stop 6
days.title: Kawe
days.summary: Whale watching, then an evening of stargazing on the Equator.

days.label: Stop 7
days.title: Aljui Bay
days.summary: A morning dive, then a three-hour cruise past the outer islands, often with dolphins and whales alongside.

days.label: Stop 8
days.title: Arborek
days.summary: Swim or dive with manta rays, which Aman says can reach wingspans of 5 metres.

days.label: Stop 1
days.title: Labuan Bajo
days.summary: The seven-day voyage leaves from Labuan Bajo on Flores.

days.label: Stop 2
days.title: Sebayur Kecil to Padar
days.summary: Turtles and reefs to snorkel and dive between Sebayur Kecil and Padar Island in Komodo National Park.

days.label: Stop 3
days.title: Loh Buaya and Tatawa Besar
days.summary: A dawn trek at Loh Buaya to see Komodo dragons, then Tatawa Besar, with an evening barbecue at Sebayur Kecil if the skies are clear.

days.label: Stop 4
days.title: Satonda
days.summary: A dive or snorkel, and an optional visit to the island's crater lake.

days.label: Stop 5
days.title: Whale sharks and Moyo
days.summary: Whale sharks at dawn near the fishing boats, a reef stop at Tanjung Pasir on Moyo Island, and a rijsttafel dinner.

days.label: Stop 6
days.title: Arrive at Amanwana
days.summary: A last breakfast on board, then arrival at Amanwana, Aman's tented camp on Moyo Island.

terms: Payment: a 30% deposit at confirmation, payable within 14 days of the invoice; a further 30% no later than 120 days before departure; the remaining 40% no later than 90 days before departure. Deposits are non-refundable under the cancellation policy.
Cancellation or change more than 90 days before departure: the deposit can go towards a replacement journey booked within 365 days of the notice.
Cancellation or change within 90 days of departure: 50% of the journey cost is forfeited, and the remainder can go towards a replacement journey booked within 365 days of the notice.
children: Aman publishes no children's policy or minimum age for Amandira. James asks Aman for your party.
faqs: How many guests does Amandira take?
Up to 10, in five air-conditioned cabins, with a crew of 14 by Aman's specification (the introduction on aman.com says 15), including two chefs, a dive master and a spa therapist.

A Master Cabin in the stern with a king bed, a living space and a large bathroom; two Deluxe Cabins on the port and starboard sides, each with a king bed and a living area; and two Single Cabins with bunk beds and their own bathrooms.
Can I book a cabin, or is it a whole-yacht charter?

Aman sails Amandira as a private yacht and tailors each itinerary to one party. Aman says the two Single Cabins are complimentary when the first three cabins are booked, with food and drink charged per person.

Aman publishes five voyages: the Komodo Cruise Expedition, the Amanwana Expedition from Labuan Bajo to Moyo Island, the Raja Ampat Expedition, the Spice Islands Expedition in the Banda Sea and the Alor Expedition.

Komodo voyages leave from Labuan Bajo on Flores (about 1 hour 15 minutes by air from Bali), Raja Ampat from Sorong, the Spice Islands from Ambon and Alor from Maumere. Aman's Private Yacht team can arrange airport transfers.
Aman publishes no rates for Amandira. James quotes the charter for your route, dates and party, and confirms what is included.
Aman's voyage pages list the private yacht, meals by the yacht's chefs with waitstaff, a PADI-certified dive master, and equipment for diving, snorkelling and kayaking; the Alor voyage adds yoga.
Aman publishes no children's policy or minimum age for Amandira. James asks Aman for your party before anything is booked.
